'''Vebb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] working for the [[Old Tion Brotherhood]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he worked for [[Gorvich]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] delivering [[Spice/Legends|spice]].
